title: xanthium strumarium var. subinerme
intro: Xanthium strumarium var. subinerme, commonly known as cocklebur, is a plant species in the sunflower family native to Eastern Asia. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which may help to relieve digestive issues, reduce fever, and protect against oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which may exhibit sedative, antispasmodic, and antiallergic effects. Studies have also identified the presence of triterpenoid saponins and phenolic acids in Xanthium strumarium var. subinerme, which may contribute to its therapeutic actions.
